# Changelog

## 2026-11-15

### Breaking changes

Run these commands in this order on an existing machine, before any other **chezmoi** command:

```sh
mkdir -p ~/.local/state/nix
mv ~/.nix-profile ~/.local/state/nix/profile
mv ~/.nix-defexpr ~/.local/state/nix/defexpr
mv ~/.nix-channels ~/.local/state/nix/channels
mv ~/.config/mise/conf.d/00-secrets.toml ~/.config/mise/config.secrets.toml
chezmoi init
NIX_CONFIG="use-xdg-base-directories = true" chezmoi apply
~/.local/state/nix/profile/bin/mise reshim --force
```

Then open a new login shell, and reload your IDE window.
